Q057.cannot: No table records customer returns or refunds linked to a product SKU. upi-refunds-june has refunds by bill_id and amount, but no SKU. pos-lines-may-june has SKU per bill line, but no return flag. There is no return line table.

Q059.cannot: Shelf audits are 11:00 snapshots on Tuesdays and Fridays only; hours off the shelf are not recorded.

Q060.cannot: No table records theft or distinguishes theft from counting error. Stock-counts-june records adjustments and their triggers (manager request after complaints, scheduled full count) but not the cause. Write-offs-june records damaged/expired units, not theft. The cause of any discrepancy is not recorded.

Q061.cannot: Restock times on the shelf are not recorded. Only back-door receipts (goods-receipts-june) and DC pick confirmations (dc-pick-confirmations-june) are recorded, not when products were placed on the shelf.

Q062.cannot: Real customer demand is not recorded. Only sales of the eleven followed items are recorded (daily-sales-june, pos-lines-may-june). Demand that found an empty shelf (lost sales) is not recorded anywhere. A forecast can only be scored against recorded sales, not demand.

Q066.cannot: The write-offs-june table records only the date, sku, units and the reason code 'damaged'. It does not record the cause of the damage (rough handling, faulty fridge, late delivery, or any other cause). No other table in the schema captures the cause of a write-off.

Q067.cannot: The records do not contain the rationale for choosing the 28-day mean forecast method. The forecasts-june table records the method used ('28-day mean of recorded sales') but not the reason it was selected. No table stores model-selection criteria, decision logs, or external factors such as seasonality, promotions, or accuracy comparisons.

Q068.cannot: No table records fridge temperature. The records cover sales, inventory, shipments, payments, complaints, audits and forecasts for the eleven followed items, but not equipment temperature.

Q069.cannot: No record captures on-shelf units at a specific time of day. Shelf audits are only at 11:00 on Tuesdays and Fridays; book stock is a daily belief, not the shelf. 10 June 2026 is a Wednesday, so no audit exists for that day.
